content.short: dEdge analyzes Solana wallet trading performance to help traders identify profitable strategies and copy trading opportunities.
content.description: dEdge is a Solana wallet performance analyzer that provides in-depth visibility into trading activity, empowering traders to identify profitable strategies and spot copy trading opportunities. Developed by veteran traders for the trading community in 2024, it combines sniper detection with precise PnL analysis, percentile breakdowns, and automated pattern recognition to separate manual traders from bots. With clear visualizations and actionable signals, dEdge helps users refine their approach, benchmark performance, and execute smarter trades with confidence.
